version.changelog: Set ClawHub category to research; preserve the existing skill behavior and slug.

llm.summary: This skill is a read-only guide for querying public Google Play data through ReplyNodes, with its external API use and credential handling disclosed.

dimensions.detail: The skill requires network calls to https://api.replynodes.com and a ReplyNodes API key, which are proportionate to the documented API-integration purpose but should be used only when the user intends to spend prepaid credits.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown documentation only; there are no executable scripts, dependencies, install hooks, or local code payloads.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions explicitly prohibit Google account access, cookies, OAuth sessions, publishing, write operations, private data, and catalog enumeration, and they require bounded pagination and input validation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, tool replacement, or local data indexing are present; the only long-lived item is the user-managed ReplyNodes API key.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to retrieve public Android app data as normalized JSON, and the documented capabilities are GET-only public-data routes for app details, search, reviews, permissions, categories, availability, and data safety.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using ReplyNodes as a third-party API provider. Keep REPLYNODES_API_KEY in a secret store, avoid pasting it into chat or logs, check capability pricing before batches, and set page or request limits so prepaid credits are not consumed unexpectedly.
llm.findings:
[YR1] expected: The matched text is a safety disclaimer saying the skill does not use cookies, OAuth sessions, publishing paths, catalog enumeration, or write operations; artifact review does not support an info-stealer concern.
[E1] expected: The external URL is the documented ReplyNodes API endpoint used for the skill's core read-only function, and the artifact instructs users to keep secrets out of logs, prompts, reports, and URLs.
[AIG SARIF] expected: The static scan reported no results, which is consistent with the artifact being documentation-only and lacking executable code or install hooks.
